request.voice_description: A ringside announcer at a 1980s world fighting tournament. Adult man, strong mid-range voice, a little gravel, loud and bright. He barks single words and short phrases with hard consonants, as if he's calling the action over a crowd through a cheap PA. No breathiness, no long vowels, no commentary.
request.text: ROUND ONE! FIGHT! SUPER! PERFECT! COUNTER! PUNISH COUNTER! REVERSAL! FIRST ATTACK! PERFECT PARRY! ALPHA COUNTER! CRUSH COUNTER! BURNOUT! CUSTOM COMBO! FIVE HIT COMBO! TWELVE HIT COMBO!
